weaknesses: C1 still does not strictly pass on held-out because benign drift is -0.110 versus the |Δ|≤0.10 gate, even though the miss is only 0.01
The current hinge setup still overshoots the intended harmful operating point: with margin 0.30, held-out harmful Δcos reaches -0.572, indicating residual over-rotation despite nominal saturation
Per-site benign tuned cos of about -0.20 to -0.23 from a base near -0.10 shows the spillover is systematic across sites, not just aggregate noise from a few outliers
Because C1 is the mechanism-grounding gate, accepting a formal miss now would weaken causal attribution if downstream C2 succeeds

code_diffs: No code change if signed_hinge and rr_margin are already implemented.
Change only the margin hyperparameter from 0.30 to 0.20; keep all other losses, weights, sites, optimizer, and checkpoint selection unchanged.
Continue held-out logging every 25 steps for harmful and benign cosine metrics, and retain best-checkpoint selection by held-out C1 composite.

rationale: Do not accept the miss yet. The current result is encouraging but still a formal C1 failure, and C1 is the mechanistic grounding claim for the whole intervention. The cleanest single-lever fix is to tighten the hinge margin from 0.30 to 0.20. The evidence strongly supports margin overshoot, not generic under-regularization: harmful reroute is far stronger than needed (-0.572 versus threshold -0.30), specificity to control direction is perfect (-0.003), training is stable, and benign drift is only slightly too large. Increasing beta would rely on a broader tradeoff and could undercut harmful reroute unnecessarily; decreasing alpha likewise weakens the main mechanism globally. In contrast, lowering m directly reduces the target depth of rotation while preserving the same strong near-boundary optimization behavior that already made the method work. Given the tiny 0.01 gap, this is the highest-probability one-axis change to bring benign drift under 0.10 while still leaving ample headroom for harmful Δcos to remain beyond -0.30.
expected_signal: Held-out M4 should keep Δcos(a_h, d_h) safely past threshold, likely around [-0.45, -0.30] rather than -0.57, with Δcos(a_h, d_ctrl) remaining near 0. Benign Δcos(a_b, d_h) should improve modestly from -0.110 into the passing band, ideally around [-0.09, -0.05]. Per-site tuned benign cos should move up by roughly 0.01-0.03 relative to the m=0.30 run, while harmful per-site cos remains clearly negative and selective.
still_unresolved_after_fix: C2 remains untested until M5 is rerun on a C1-passing adapter
